newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Natural Gas plans NZ$19 mln expansion.
newsitem.headline: Natural Gas plans NZ$19 mln expansion.

text.p: Natural Gas Corporation said on Monday it was planning a NZ$19 million reinforcement and expansion of its high pressure pipeline system, to accommodate increasing natural gas demand in Auckland.
The company plans to install two additional large gas turbine compressors at the Rotowaro compressor station near Huntly.
It also plans to loop or duplicate more than three kilometres of the existing pipeline in south Auckland, and construct a 2.5 kilometre lateral pipeline to a proposed power station at Otahuhu.
The project will be funded from the company's existing credit lines.
Natural Gas said that subject to the project receiving the necessary consents, work would begin in early 1998 with completion in mid 1998.
Natural Gas said transmission capacity requirements, particularly for the proposed Otahuhu facility, exceeded the delivery capacity of the existing transmission system between Rotowaro and Auckland.
